name: GBA Window Control
description: Controls the GBA TV window, in single-player mode.

fields.name: Window Position
fields.description: Determines where the GBA window is positioned on the screen.

31.name: Centered, Disabled by trigger
31.description: Keeps the GBA window closed while the trigger is active.

fields.name: Trigger Duration
fields.description: The duration in frames for which the GBA window remains disabled after the trigger activates.

fields.name: Trigger local Variable
fields.description: The local variable used to trigger the window control.
